decisive_items: apex of the heart located at the right side of the chest
right atrium and right ventricle laid on the left side and the left atrium and left ventricle on the right side with its apex directed to the right
response.rationale: Dextrocardia with situs inversus is the more specific diagnosis given the unique anatomical arrangement of the heart and its position in the chest, as evidenced by both physical examination and imaging findings.

rejected.why: While the ECG findings support complete right bundle branch block, they do not fully explain the anatomical anomalies observed.
